headline: Microsoft and Discord subpoenaed over GTA VI gameplay leaks
summary: Subpoenas issued to Microsoft and Discord as authorities investigate the source of leaked Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay footage.
details: Leaked clips of Grand Theft Auto VI, reportedly watermarked by "CyberLeek," have surfaced online. These clips showcase gameplay featuring protagonist Jason Duval, including driving, flying, and combat sequences.
The leaks have emerged ahead of Rockstar Games' official extended preview of GTA VI, scheduled to debut on Netflix on August 27th. The full game is slated for release on November 19th.
Authorities have reportedly issued subpoenas to Microsoft and Discord in an effort to identify the individuals or groups responsible for distributing the leaked gameplay footage.
Neither Microsoft nor Discord immediately responded to requests for comment regarding the subpoenas or their involvement in the investigation.
caption:
Microsoft and Discord are being investigated over leaked Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay footage.

Leaked clips of Grand Theft Auto VI, reportedly watermarked by "CyberLeek," have surfaced online. These clips showcase gameplay featuring protagonist Jason Duval, including driving, flying, and combat sequences.

The leaks have emerged ahead of Rockstar Games' official extended preview of GTA VI, scheduled to debut on Netflix on August 27th. The full game is slated for release on November 19th.

Authorities have reportedly issued subpoenas to Microsoft and Discord in an effort to identify the individuals or groups responsible for distributing the leaked gameplay footage.

Neither Microsoft nor Discord immediately responded to requests for comment regarding the subpoenas or their involvement in the investigation.

Source: The Verge
